title: Console metrics & ad-hoc export intake framework for enterprise requests
creator: Ana Castillo
description: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization framework specifically for console analytics, usage/cost breakdown requests, and ad-hoc export needs from enterprise customers. Aim: reduce time-to-triage, standardize data contracts, and route high-value requests to the right sequence (Quick Win vs. Engineering Project vs. Data Team deliverable).
acceptance_criteria: Public intake form template created and published in Confluence
Prioritization rubric (impact x frequency x effort) defined and approved by PM, Eng, and Solutions teams
Routing rules implemented in Linear: Quick Win -> ENG backlog; Data contract work -> Data/Analytics project board; Enterprise exports -> Security review checklist applied
3 sample enterprise requests re-triaged using the new flow with documented outcomes
A draft billing estimate template for ad-hoc export work is available to Sales/Success
decisions: Export formats supported initially: CSV, Parquet, BigQuery exports (customer-owned project) - chosen for broad compatibility
Default retention for ad-hoc exports: 30 days in staging export bucket unless customer requests longer and signs data contract
Large dataset exports (>100M rows) will be scoped as engineering projects with cost estimate and cadence (streaming vs snapshot)
Enterprise requests requiring raw logs or PII will trigger mandatory Security & Legal review before scheduling
tradeoffs: Fast, ad-hoc CSV exports are highest short-term velocity but increase operator load and potential cost spikes
Tighter data contracts and programmatic exports (BigQuery sink) increase initial engineering cost but scale better for repeatable needs
Automatic sampling reduces cost but may reduce fidelity for chargeback and compliance use cases
implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize intake form fields and create Confluence page with examples (owner: PM)
Week 2: Build Linear automation rules and labels; set up triage rota for CS/Sales to tag enterprise requests (owner: Ops)
Week 3-4: Implement minimal export runner in Data infra for CSV/Parquet with quotas and audit logs (owner: ENG, dependent ENG-2124)
Week 5: Pilot with 3 enterprise customers; collect feedback and adjust prioritization weights
Post-pilot: Formalize pricing/billing template and add to Sales enablement
